prose.summary: Reconciled source purposes: [1] Define explicit remote DWH input scopes `all`, `ext` and `id` at the origin so remote exposure is selected before transfer rather than inferred by the receiver. [2] Define the canonical remote input scope modes `all`, `ext` and `id` as explicit origin-side ingestion boundaries rather than heuristic filters.

references.purpose: Remote input scope is enforced at origin.

semantics.all_rule: `all` accepts the full explicitly permitted remote input set within the owning origin/schema policy.
semantics.authority_rule: Input scope describes admissible data class/scope and is not authorization by itself.
semantics.authorization_rule: Scope limits candidate data but does not replace IAM/AC authorization.
semantics.default_rule: No broader scope is inferred from transport connectivity.
semantics.explicit_rule: Remote scope is explicit configuration/policy data.
semantics.ext_rule: `ext` accepts only data classified/identified as external according to the owning origin/schema contract.
semantics.id_rule: `id` accepts only explicitly identity-scoped/identity-classified data according to the owning contract.
semantics.identity_rule: Scope token is policy mode, not data/resource identity.
semantics.lineage_rule: Released data retains origin, scope and lineage provenance.
semantics.origin_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Scope is evaluated at the data origin before remote transfer. [2] Remote input scope is evaluated at the receiving/origin ingestion boundary.
semantics.receiver_rule: Receiver cannot widen the origin-selected scope.
semantics.schema_rule: Scope selection does not bypass schema validation/classification.

scopes.all: all data permitted by the owning DWH policy

semantics.unknown_rule: Unknown scope mode hard-fails rather than falling back to `all`.
